scope.candidateRule: TypeScript files containing a durable lock, atomic JSON write, instance serialization queue, or direct file write/append/rename marker.

entries.ownership: Local action receipts are shared by agent process incarnations.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Processing mutations remain fenced after restart; only journal-bound completion can settle them.

entries.ownership: Approval decisions and execution leases are shared across local-agent restarts.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Expired or in-use approvals fail closed and remain bound to exact action and authority.

entries.ownership: Reset intent is locally persisted under separate recovery authority.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Interrupted reset retains a typed phase record and cannot imply successful authority cleanup.

entries.ownership: Emergency-stop authority is shared by all local execution entry points.
entries.recoveryBoundary: An engaged or corrupt stop record freezes execution across restart until separately authorized clearing.

entries.ownership: Original-device recovery decisions are locally signed and process bound.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Only a matching never-dispatched journal prefix may receive a no-replay terminal decision.

entries.ownership: Relay credentials are owned by one local agent but survive its restart.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Rotation preserves the current unexpired credential and never exposes a stale token as current.

entries.ownership: The protected local state directory has one exact process-instance owner.
entries.recoveryBoundary: PID reuse and unknowable liveness do not permit stealing an active or ambiguous state lock.

entries.ownership: Each relay state directory has one exact process-instance writer owner.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Restart may reclaim only a provably dead exact owner; ambiguous ownership remains locked.

entries.ownership: Account membership and generation state is shared by relay server instances.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Durable high-water generations and release markers fence stale owners through cleanup and restart.

entries.ownership: Action transition history is shared by task, relay, and recovery components.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Signed monotonic transitions prohibit replay and retain uncertain or dispatched mutations for reconciliation.

entries.ownership: Audit segments may receive events from independent runtime components.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Cross-segment hash continuity detects edits while bounded rotation preserves an authenticated head.

entries.ownership: Compensation intents are shared across durable workflow restarts.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Pending intents survive restart and resolution cannot discard unrelated compensation records.

entries.ownership: Embedded files or PostgreSQL rows are shared by control-plane workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Tombstone generations never recycle after delete, expiry, purge, restart, or witnessed restore.

entries.ownership: Conversation intent records are shared across task submission and recovery.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Generation checks prevent stale conversation intent from becoming current after restart.

entries.ownership: Desired-state contracts and leases are shared by reconciliation workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Effectful expired work becomes uncertain and requires reconciliation rather than automatic replay.

entries.ownership: Developer container records are owned by exact managed runtime identities.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Restart reconstruction retains exact container identity and refuses foreign lifecycle reconciliation.

entries.ownership: Developer runtime ownership records coordinate managed child processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Stale PID or changed process identity cannot authorize termination of a replacement process.

entries.ownership: Developer session plan, verification and resource metadata are shared by concurrent session coordinators.
entries.recoveryBoundary: An exact-owner cross-process lock and monotonically updated timestamps reject stale or same-time conflicting persisted session records.

entries.ownership: Managed worktree records are shared by developer session operations.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact repository and revision identity fences cleanup and resumption after process restart.

entries.ownership: Enrollment codes and claims are shared by device pairing processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: One-use enrollment and account binding remain atomic across competing claims and restart.

entries.ownership: Cryptographic device identity is owned by the protected local state instance.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Identity creation is exclusive and persisted identity corruption fails closed instead of rotating silently.

entries.ownership: Reservations and capacity are shared by device scheduling workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Prepared reservations retain request provenance and crash recovery never duplicates capacity allocation.

entries.ownership: Device inventory is shared by registration, routing, and pool schedulers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Generation and capacity updates are serialized and corrupt persisted identities fail closed.

entries.ownership: Device reset phase state coordinates identity and dependent-store cleanup.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Restart resumes from a durable phase without recreating revoked identity or forgetting partial cleanup.

entries.ownership: Project and default routes are shared by account routing workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Routes remain bound to active exact device generations and do not silently fall back after revocation.

entries.ownership: Operation reservations and confirmations are shared by restart recovery.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Burned identifiers and prepared external effects remain fenced after abrupt process death.

entries.ownership: Model budget reservations are shared by task planners across restarts.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Unknown model spend remains charged until reconciliation and cannot be refunded by a restart.

entries.ownership: Saga state and execution ownership are shared by workflow processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Only the exact execution owner advances a saga; mutations recover from journal evidence without redispatch.

entries.ownership: This primitive serializes legitimate processes sharing one durable file.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Process identity and boot identity prevent unsafe stale-lock theft across PID reuse or host changes.

entries.ownership: Atomic durable-state helpers serve stores with separately defined ownership.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Temporary-file write, synchronization, and rename prevent partial JSON from becoming committed state.

entries.ownership: Enterprise grants, revocations, and halt state are shared across workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Revocation and emergency halt win atomically over concurrent child issuance and survive restart.

entries.ownership: Enterprise principal mappings are shared by policy and execution workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact principal types and generations prevent stale or coerced identity from regaining authority.

entries.ownership: Enterprise policy generations are shared by all authorization boundaries.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Every update advances a durable generation and malformed parent authority fails closed.

entries.ownership: Evaluation run records are exclusive evidence artifacts for one campaign.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exclusive output and immutable run identity prevent overwriting a prior scored evidence artifact.

entries.ownership: Event definitions and executions are shared across event providers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Provider receipt provenance and terminal evidence survive concurrent writers and restart.

entries.ownership: Strategy and outcome receipts are shared by optimization workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Receipt identity makes retries idempotent and retains every distinct concurrent outcome.

entries.ownership: Intent generations are shared by task planning and provider dispatch.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Supersession advances durable generation so stale actions fail immediately before dispatch.

entries.ownership: Operation trace segments receive events from independent runtime stages.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Cross-instance appends retain correlation while bounded records exclude authority and secret payloads.

entries.ownership: Organization mission and compensation state is shared by coordinators.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Partial starts retain exact child ownership and restart compensates only source-matched children.

entries.ownership: Quarantine decisions form a signed chain shared by review processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: External high-water witness and exact scope prevent ledger truncation, replay, or foreign adjudication.

entries.ownership: Consumed independent outcome receipt identifiers and nonces are shared across task verification processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: One-use nonce and receipt digest remain durable after restart; missing or corrupt replay history must fail closed.

entries.ownership: Perception graph observations are shared by ingestion and publication.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Observation lineage and source identity remain monotonic across concurrent graph updates.

entries.ownership: Verified procedure outcomes are shared by learning and execution workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Only receipt-bound verified outcomes update memory and saturated storage fails closed.

entries.ownership: Production trust anchors and signer observations belong to external administrators.
entries.recoveryBoundary: External reviewer, signer, and high-water identities must all match before trust composition succeeds.

entries.ownership: Provider learning samples are shared by advisory optimization workers.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Bounded receipt identity prevents duplicate outcomes and unverified evidence from changing production authority.

entries.ownership: Delivery queues are shared by relay connections and result recovery.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Monotonic sequence, authority generation, ACK identity, and tombstones prevent replay after reconnect or restore.

entries.ownership: Reservation recovery intents are shared by relay control processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact reservation and operation binding retains uncertain attempts and rejects foreign resolution.

entries.ownership: Result streams and idempotency records are shared by relay services.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Unconsumed mutation results persist until ACK and stale authority generations cannot recreate replay state.

entries.ownership: Resource leases coordinate all local provider execution processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact process identity, generation, and mutation quarantine prevent stale ownership or uncertain replay.

entries.ownership: Semantic checkpoints are shared by migration and verification flows.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact state digest and generation prevent applying a checkpoint to changed or foreign resources.

entries.ownership: Session token lineage and revocation is shared by relay services.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Rotation, expiry, revocation, and bounded predecessor history persist across restart and reject replay.

entries.ownership: Advisory shadow decisions are appended by independent planners.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Concurrent append and restart retain all bounded decisions without granting execution authority.

entries.ownership: State snapshots are explicit local maintenance artifacts with one creator.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Manifest hashes and bounded catalog identity prevent a partial or unrelated snapshot from being trusted.

entries.ownership: Studio run state is shared by API and executor instances.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Execution leases and uncertain effects prevent a restarted executor from duplicating a workflow mutation.

entries.ownership: Taught workflow drafts and compiled forms are shared by studio sessions.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Generations and exact compiled identity prevent concurrent drafts from silently overwriting each other.

entries.ownership: Task state and execution leases are shared by API and orchestrator processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: CAS-like task generation and execution lease identity prevent lost updates and duplicate resumed execution.

entries.ownership: Mission, work-item, and worker leases are shared by team processes.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Worker revocation and lease expiry persist before cancellation so stale workers cannot commit results.

entries.ownership: Managed terminal sessions are shared across process-provider instances.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Exact PID and creation identity permit safe orphan recovery without killing a PID-reused replacement.

entries.ownership: World observations and claims are shared by multiple evidence sources.
entries.recoveryBoundary: Concurrent distinct source claims are retained with provenance and cannot overwrite verified history.
